cues.en: I pray silence for the president of the Royal Society for putting things on top of other things.
cues.zh: 我祈求各位为皇家学会主席安静一下，他擅长把东西叠在其他东西上面。

cues.en: The year has been a good one for the society. This
cues.zh: 今年对学会来说是个好年头。

cues.en: year our members have put more things on top of other things than ever before.
cues.zh: 今年我们的成员把更多东西叠在其他东西上面，比以往任何时候都多。

cues.en: But I should warn you this is no time for complacency.
cues.zh: 但我得提醒你们，现在可不是自满的时候。

cues.en: No there are still many things and I cannot emphasize this too strongly not on top of other things.
cues.zh: 不，还有很多东西，我再怎么强调也不为过，没有叠在其他东西上面。

cues.en: on my way here this evening saw a thing that was not on top of another thing in any way. Jane
cues.zh: 今晚来这里的路上，我看见了一样东西，它完全没有放在另一件东西上面。简

cues.en: But we must not allow ourselves to become too despondent
cues.zh: 但我们不能让自己太过沮丧

cues.en: we must never forget that if there was not one thing that was not on top of another thing our society would be nothing more than the meaningless body of men that gathered together for no good purpose.
cues.zh: 我们绝不能忘记，要是没有一样东西放在另一件东西上面，我们的社会就只不过是一群毫无目的地聚在一起的人，毫无意义。
